title: AMBA Rising-Edge Sampling and Valid Windows
description: A cycle-level teaching view of an AHB HCLK or AXI ACLK input becoming stable before, and remaining stable after, its protocol sampling edge; setup and hold intervals are implementation constraints and are not drawn to scale.

annotations.message: The input is LOW at this rising edge. The protocol samples the value present at the edge; implementation setup and hold checks apply around it.
SIGNAL_A becomes HIGH early enough to satisfy the receiving register's setup requirement before the next rising edge.
This rising edge samples SIGNAL_A as HIGH. It must remain stable for the implementation's hold interval after the edge; an RTL X is not a literal analog metastable voltage.
